# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the **Contributor Covenant v2.1** verbatim.

The full text is published at:
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

## Reporting

If you experience or witness conduct that falls outside the Contributor
Covenant when participating in this project (issues, PRs, discussions),
please report to:

`conduct@testland.io`

All reports are reviewed by the maintainers and treated as confidential.

## Enforcement

The maintainers follow the Contributor Covenant **Enforcement Guidelines**
(Section 4 of the linked document) when responding to reports.
